lines.en: Hello. I'm Kim Minsu from next door.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, yes! Nice to meet you. I'm Lee Jieun.
lines.beaver_roman: a, ne! bangawoyo. jeoneun i jieunieyo.
lines.en: Nice to meet you. You moved in, so I came to say hi.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, thank you so much. Come in.
lines.en: No, it's okay. Sorry I came so late.

lines.beaver_en: Not at all. I moved here last month.
lines.en: I'm sorry. I was busy, so I had no time.

lines.beaver_en: That's fine. But is something up?
lines.en: Excuse me, but I have a favor to ask.

lines.learner: 다음 주에 일주일 동안 여행을 가요.
lines.en: I'm going on a trip for a week next week.
lines.roman: daeum jue iljuil dongan yeohaengeul gayo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, sounds nice! Who will watch your house?
lines.learner: 아무도 없어요. 화분에 물 좀 주실래요?
lines.en: No one. Could you water my plants?
lines.roman: amudo eopseoyo. hwabune mul jom jusillaeyo?

lines.en: Thank you so much for helping me.

lines.beaver_en: Not at all. Neighbors should help each other.
lines.en: Yes, that's right. It was really nice meeting you.
